title: AReno classify_rl operator contract (STS1/STS2)
description: Transport-agnostic JSON contract between an environment operator (real-game headless, simulator, or any decision env) and a rollout worker that produces decisions.jsonl for AReno's --algo classify_rl. Message bodies validate against the shapes under $defs. A conforming HTTP operator exposes POST /reset, POST /step, POST /snapshot, POST /restore, GET /capabilities, all taking/returning the matching bodies. A stdio operator reads/writes newline-delimited JSON of the same shapes. Scope: single-episode-at-a-time; vectorized backends thread multiple episode_ids under this same contract.

DecisionPoint.description: What kind of choice the agent is making. Targeted combat actions (e.g. 'Strike enemy 0' vs 'Strike enemy 1') are expanded into separate Candidates under combat_play, not a separate decision point. Potions appear as additional candidates in whichever decision point they are legal.

Character.description: Union of STS1 and STS2 characters. Backends declare their actual support in Capabilities.characters.

EpisodeScope.description: 'battle' puts the operator into a single combat encounter; 'full_run' runs the whole climb from Neow to the last boss.

Candidate.description: One legal action at a decision point. The operator sends only legal candidates in a stable deterministic order; the Jev score head reads 'text' as its candidate suffix and the rollout worker echoes 'id' back to the operator in StepRequest.action_id.

id.description: Opaque backend-specific action id. Must be stable within an episode; two candidates in the same packet must have different ids.

text.description: Human- and model-readable rendering (card name, numeric effect, target). Keep rendering stable across operator versions so cached Jev checkpoints stay comparable.

Info.description: Side-channel structured facts for reward shaping, logging, and advantage computation. Not fed to the Jev prompt.

hp.description: Current HP after the previous step's effects.

energy.description: Only populated in combat decision points.

outcome.description: Set only on terminal packets. 'win' = cleared the scope; 'loss' = HP->0; 'quit' = caller aborted; 'timeout' = step budget exhausted.

StatePacket.description: Response body for /reset, /step, /restore. One packet = one decision point (or terminal 'game_over'). The operator renders 'state_text' as the Jev prompt; rendering template is operator-specific but must be stable within a backend version so cached checkpoints stay comparable across runs.

step.description: 0 on the packet returned by /reset; +1 per /step response.

done.description: True iff this is the terminal packet (decision_point='game_over').

reward.description: Scalar reward attributed to the transition that produced this packet; 0 on the reset packet. Operator picks a default shaping; rollout workers may override by recomputing from Info.

state_text.description: Rendered digest fed to the Jev score head as prompt. Operators MUST keep this within the deployment's max_seq_len (1536 tokens on the reference Ling-3.0-tiny recipe).

state_struct.description: Optional raw structured state echo for debugging and reward recomputation.

candidates.description: Legal candidates, stable deterministic order. Terminal packets send a single sentinel candidate (id='terminal', text='<game_over>').

seed.description: Backend-defined seed string; null = backend picks one and reports it on the state packet.

battle_setup.description: Required when episode_scope='battle'. Backend-specific encounter spec (enemy_id, floor, deck override, relics, HP).

episode_id.description: Caller-supplied id, otherwise the operator generates one.

action_id.description: One of the ids from the previous StatePacket.candidates.

old_logp.description: Behavior-policy log probability of the chosen candidate, if known. Operator persists it on its decision log so the rollout worker can retrieve it when assembling DecisionLogRow.

token.description: Opaque; feed back into /restore. Backends that cannot snapshot MUST return HTTP 501 (or {"error": "unsupported"} over stdio) and advertise supports_snapshot=false in Capabilities.

Capabilities.description: Response body of GET /capabilities. Lets the rollout worker pick a backend without probing.

paired_seed_bit_exact.description: True iff reset(seed=X) followed by identical actions is byte-identical across invocations. Required for paired-seed advantage baselines.

DecisionLogRow.description: One line of decisions.jsonl, consumed verbatim by areno.experimental.classify.rl_trainer.encode_decision. Produced by the rollout worker from an episode of StatePackets: prompt=StatePacket.state_text at decision time; candidates=[c.text for c in packet.candidates]; chosen=index of the picked candidate; old_logp from StepRequest.old_logp (or recomputed by the worker); advantage from a return-minus-baseline over the full episode; sft_target when a teacher distribution is being distilled; meta carries bookkeeping for diffing against the operator log and is ignored by the trainer.

sft_target.description: Optional per-candidate probability distribution (sums to 1 within 1e-4). When present on any row of a dataset it MUST be present on every row, because sequence-label keys must be uniform in a training pack.

meta.description: Opaque bookkeeping: episode_id, decision_point, step, seed, info snapshot. Ignored by the trainer.
